purpose: Teach: 小川/右側/パーツ/コンパクト/ストア/キャッシュ/漁業/五輪

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、お店の近くの、絶対、小川、絶対、見てきたわ
lines.en: Aoi, I actually went down and checked out that little stream near your shop.
lines.style: Gentle opening, warm curiosity. Slow pace, almost thoughtful. Voice lifts slightly at the end—sharing something she's noticed, inviting her in.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、右側、絶対、メニュー、絶対、貼ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. You know, I actually just posted the new menu on the right side of the shop.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, conversational. Light, efficient delivery. No flourish—just a practical update shared easily, like it's part of the rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、コーヒーマシンの、絶対、パーツ、絶対、新しく、絶対、しないと、絶対、ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, honestly, you really should think about replacing some of those coffee machine parts soon.
lines.style: Gentle but direct, no hedging. Concerned tone underneath—she cares about the shop. Steady pace, warm insistence without pressure.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、コンパクト、絶対、な、絶対、レイアウト、絶対、気に入ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, but I really do love the compact layout we've got. It suits the space perfectly.
lines.style: Steady, grounded voice. Pride in her space—not defensive, just honest. Even pace, warm and genuine. She's thought about this.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、駅前の、絶対、ストア、絶対、新しいの、絶対、できたの、メイちゃん、絶対、気になるわ
lines.en: Aoi, I have to say, that new shop that opened in front of the station is kind of catching my eye.
lines.style: Curious, slightly hesitant—she's testing the waters. Tone is thoughtful, not critical. Soft pace with a gentle lift on 'catching my eye,' inviting conversation rather than comparison.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お会計、絶対、キャッシュ、絶対、レス、絶対、対応してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We're actually doing cashless payments now too, if that helps with anything.
lines.style: Bright, practical tone. Light pace—she's keeping up with things, staying current. Slight warmth underneath, like she's proud of the small improvements.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお父さん、本気で、絶対、漁業、絶対、お仕事、絶対、続けていらっしゃるんでしょ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi's father is still working in fishing, isn't he? Is he still doing well with that?
lines.style: Gentle, inquiring tone. Respectful curiosity about someone she doesn't know as well. Slow, warm pace. The question carries genuine interest, not small talk.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、五輪、絶対、選手、絶対、応援、絶対、お店で、絶対、配信してるよ、メイちゃん、本気for
lines.en: You know, we've actually been streaming the Olympics at the shop—cheering on the athletes with customers. It's been really fun.
lines.style: Animated, bright energy. Smile in the voice. Upbeat pace with enthusiasm that isn't forced. She's genuinely happy about this small community moment.
